description: Get the pickup schedule for each service address: pickup day(s), next service date, the official set-out-by time, and an observed arrival-time window (earliest/latest/typical and whether it is consistent or varies) derived from the recorded collection times in your service history. Crown Town Compost publishes no guaranteed arrival window, so the observed window is empirical. Read-only.

history_sample.description: How many recent stops to derive the observed time window from (max 100).

name: crowntown_get_pickup_schedule
title: Get pickup schedule (days + time window)
